candidates.reason: A six-checkpoint web-service workflow with a previously observed tractable checkpoint 1, but no DeepSeek recursive-treatment outcomes.
A four-checkpoint data-processing CLI whose checkpoint 1 previously retained non-perfect headroom, but no DeepSeek recursive-treatment outcomes.
A four-checkpoint stateful backup workflow that supplies exactly three prospective manager updates and has no DeepSeek recursive-treatment outcomes.

selection_rule.advance: A candidate has no infrastructure failure, every checkpoint 1 through 4 explicitly completes before action 32, and checkpoint 4 normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50.
selection_rule.headroom: Checkpoint 4 must fail at least one collected test or one Core test.
selection_rule.tie_break: Prefer greater checkpoint-4 all-test headroom, then fewer checkpoint-4 actions, then the shorter cumulative public specification.
selection_rule.reject: Reject a candidate if any checkpoint is action-boundary censored, has infrastructure failure, or checkpoint 4 scores below 0.50 on either normalized measure.
selection_rule.abandon: If no candidate qualifies, do not run a four-checkpoint DeepSeek recursive-manager contrast under this budget.

formal_if_valid.replication_policy: If treatment-control all-test gaps are negative at checkpoints 3 and 4, add two identical independent replicates. Otherwise stop the selected model-task-provider pair.
